why: In each pair, the small shape that was inside becomes the big outer shape, and the old outer shape becomes a small black shape sitting on top. The triangle with a square inside becomes a square with a small triangle on top. So the circle with a triangle inside becomes a triangle with a small circle on top: option 3. Option 4 has the circle on top of a square, the wrong big shape.
trick: Ask: which shape was inside, and which was outside? Then swap their sizes.
